leftEvidence.title: Strangers to the covenants of promise

points.label: Covenant setting
points.left: Plural covenant memory appears inside a movement from distance to nearness and from divided groups toward peace.
points.right: Covenant identity and Abrahamic blessing are brought together in apostolic proclamation.

points.label: Parties, action, or promise
points.left: Gentiles · Israel · both groups · Covenants of promise · Blood of Christ · Far off → brought near
points.right: Peter · Israel · Abraham · Covenant with fathers · Families of earth blessed · Turn from wickedness

payload.posture: Ephesians names former distance from covenants of promise; Acts addresses Israel through covenant ancestry and Abrahamic blessing.

rightEvidence.title: Children of the prophets and covenant

payload.tension: The two sources materially share covenant language or memory, while their parties, setting, action, or literary purpose remain distinct.
